backend/main.mo: Motoko actor for a home services backend that manages bookings and reviews, providing CRUD operations including add, get, update, delete, and filter functions for both entities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the Footer component was updated to display a specific address (Sharath M, 12th Cross Mookambika Nagar, Banashankari 3rd Stage, Hosakerehalli, Bangalore – 560085) while keeping the email unchanged.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key implementation details for the TrustFix home services app.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme design tokens (colors, radius, chart, sidebar variables).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the TrustFix React app with cache-control meta tags, Google site verification, and a root div that mounts the Vite/React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, services (with optional category search param), legacy service detail, booking, contact, and reviews pages, wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormPopup: Modal booking form popup that collects customer details (name, mobile, address, service, property type, date/time) and submits by opening a pre-filled WhatsApp message link.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: Animated card component for cleaning services that displays an image, price badge, features, and Book Now / WhatsApp action buttons with intersection-observer-based fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Auto-advancing carousel component that fetches and displays featured customer reviews from the backend, with navigation controls and star ratings.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed-position floating button on the left side that opens a WhatsApp chat link when clicked.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed-position floating WhatsApp button on the right side with a pulse animation and notification dot that opens a WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the TrustFix brand, contact info, address, social links, service category links, and quick navigation links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-width hero banner with an overlay, headline, and two CTA buttons that open WhatsApp with pre-filled booking or call messages.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper that composes Navbar, Footer, and FloatingWhatsAppButton around child content, and scrolls to top on route changes.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop links, a mobile hamburger menu, a service search dropdown, and a WhatsApp call button.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: Animated card component for a painting service item showing an image, price badge, star rating, features, and buttons to book via WhatsApp or request a free inspection.
A card component for displaying pest control services with an image, price badge, feature list, and WhatsApp/Book Now action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a customer review with avatar initials, star rating, service label, date, and review text.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: An animated service card with intersection observer visibility, showing an image, price, features, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons.
A carousel component that displays service categories as clickable cards with fallback images, navigating to the services page with a category query param on click.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: A grid of service category cards with scroll-triggered fade-in animations, fallback images, and navigation to the services page filtered by category.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Renders a row of star icons for a given rating, supporting optional interactive mode with a click handler.
An animated card for individual service subcategories showing image, price, features, and Get Quote/Book Now buttons with WhatsApp integration.
A React form component that allows users to submit reviews with name, service type, star rating, and review text, using a TanStack mutation to call the backend actor and invalidating review queries on success.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for all service categories (pest control, cleaning, painting, etc.) along with contact constants and a WhatsApp link helper function.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using TanStack Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
Custom hook that exposes a TanStack mutation to submit a booking to the backend actor and then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to the component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports three TanStack Query hooks for fetching featured reviews, all reviews, and all bookings from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Custom hook that filters and returns up to 8 deduplicated service search results matching a query string against category and service names/descriptions.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins and Inter fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and declares Tailwind layers with component styles and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: A booking form page that collects user details (name, phone, address, service, property type, date, time) and sends the booking as a pre-filled WhatsApp message to TrustFix. Conditionally shows property type and square footage fields for certain services.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact page displaying TrustFix's phone/WhatsApp, address, email, and working hours as clickable cards, plus an embedded Google Map section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The homepage composing HeroSection, trust badges, ServiceCarousel, a 'Why Choose Us' grid, FeaturedReviewsCarousel, and a WhatsApp CTA banner.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: A reviews page that fetches all reviews from the backend actor via React Query and displays them in a grid of ReviewCards alongside a WriteReviewForm.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: A services listing page with category filtering, subcategory cards, and a dedicated PaintingPackageCard layout; supports a booking popup and WhatsApp deep links.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom brand colors, fonts (Inter/Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and animations (fadeInUp, cardEnter, pulse-slow, wave) for the TrustFix frontend.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for TrustFix tracking schema version, existing features (footer address update), and project configuration like clarification mode.
